⏱ 🟦 CA Inter · 8-second MCQ challenge

Neel Ltd has 8,00,000 equity shares of ₹10 each fully paid, general reserve ₹50,00,000, Profit and Loss balance ₹30,00,000 and capital reserve ₹10,00,000. It buys back shares at ₹50 each, using the highest limit for paid-up capital and free reserves under a special resolution. Maximum shares it can buy back?
